title: The Rat Roads
text:
*You drift away from the line casually, as though stretching your legs. Twenty paces along the wall, half-hidden by a collapsed cart, you spot it — a drainage grate, rusted but loose.*

*The tunnel beyond is narrow and stinking, but short. You emerge in a cellar that smells of old wine and rat droppings. Upstairs, muffled voices.*

A figure steps from the shadows — lean, hooded, a knife glinting at her belt.

Sable: "Well, well. Someone who knows to use the rat roads. Either you're very clever or very desperate. Which is it?"

*Her eyes are sharp and amused. This woman knows these tunnels like her own veins.*

choices.text: "Clever enough to find this passage. I'm looking for information."
Say nothing and push past her toward the exit
